data.longBusinessSummary: Diageo plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, marketing, and sale of alcoholic beverages in North America, the Europe, the Asia Pacific, Latin America and Caribbean, and the Africa. The company offers scotch, gin, vodka, rum, raki, liqueur, wine, tequila, Chinese white spirits, cachaça, and brandy, as well as beer, including cider and flavored malt beverages. It also provides Chinese, Canadian, Irish, American, and Indian whiskies, as well as flavored malt beverages, ready to drink, and non-alcoholic products. The company provides its products under the Johnnie Walker, Crown Royal, SEEDLIP, DELEON, LAGAVULIN, 21 SEEDS, PIMM'S, Hop House 13 Lager, CACIQUE, KILKENNY, SHERIDAN'S, MORTLACH, J&B, Buchanan's, Smirnoff, Cîroc, Ketel One, Captain Morgan, Baileys, Don Julio, Casamigos, Tanqueray, Guinness, ROE & CO, TALISKER, THE SINGLETON, Shui Jing Fang, Yenì raki, McDowell's, Don Papa, Aviation American, Seagram's 7 Crown, Zacapa, Black Dog, Black & White, Signature, Royal Challenge, Godawan, Antiquity, Gordon's, Old Parr, Bundaberg, Bulleit, and Bell's brand names. The company was formerly known as Guinness plc and changed its name to Diageo plc in February 1998. The company was incorporated in 1886 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
